Faber Castell Goldfaber Graphite lead Pencil with Eraser Box of 12

Faber Castell
116801
In stock
Drawing & Drafting
Rs.600

The Goldfaber graphite pencil with eraser is a versatile graphite pencil for drawing and sketching. These graphite pencils convince with their good writing performance. The hexagonal shape and the break-resistant lead with the typical Faber-Castell SV bonding make them an ideal companion during drawing and sketching for students and young artists.

  • High quality for writing, drawing and sketching
  •  Blue barrel with golden stripes
  •  Break-resistant lead due to secural bonding process (SV)
  •  Degree of hardness: HB
